desc: entry point: jp $0150 -> jp $2E8D (WRAM-clear stub, then continue to $0150)

boot stub in bank0 padding: save A, zero WRAM $C000-$DFFF, restore A, jp $0150. Fixes phantom trunk cards: the game never initializes the $CAE4 collection array before use, so cores that power on with garbage WRAM (real DMG, Miyoo) show ~random cards as owned. Zeroed WRAM at entry reproduces the known-good conditions; SRAM loads afterwards, so valid saves are untouched.
